title: I love cauldron
description: This modpack adds utilities and optimizations to your game!
body:
### I love Cauldron!
This modpack adds mods for optimization, improved graphics and utilities. You can use it as a game in the normal world and in the server.

### About Mods...
Optimization is selected so that the assembly is good both on weak and good computers.
QoL mods add minimal conveniences for the player both in the normal and server world.
Cosmetic mods for graphics and particles will complement your game nicely.

Thanks for playing on our Modpack

So enjoy the game on our Modpack!
